logp.method_description: The lipophilicity of iridium complexes Ir1-Ir3 were determined by shake flask method. The n-octanol (20 ml) and PBS (20 ml) were shaked together at 25°C and 120 r/min for 24 h to allow saturation of both phases. Iridium complexes Ir1-Ir3 (20 μL, 10 mM) were dissolved in 2 ml of PBS saturated with n-octanol, and then added to an equal amount of n-octanol saturated with PBS. The mixture was shaked at 25°C and 120 r/min for 6 h. After the two phases were separated, the concentrations of these complexes in the organic and aqueous phases were determined using UV-vis spectrophotometer. LogPo/w was defined as the logarithmic ratio of the concentrations of Ir1-Ir3 in the organic and aqueous phase.
